title: HyperDapp
tagline: HyperDapp: A graph-powered dApp registry with ratings weighted by real on-chain use.
description:
HyperDapp is a decentralized application registry that combines The Graph Substreams and Hypergraph technology to deliver the most accurate and trustworthy picture of the dApp ecosystem. Instead of relying on anonymous, one-click ratings, HyperDapp analyzes real on-chain interactions between wallets and smart contracts to weight every score by actual usage. This means a rating from an active user carries more influence than one from a drive-by visitor.

Developers can showcase their projects with verifiable metrics, while users can discover new dApps with confidence, knowing that rankings are based on transparent, tamper-resistant data streamed directly from the blockchain. By merging high-performance indexing with a powerful knowledge graph, HyperDapp turns raw contract events into actionable insights and a living map of the decentralized world.
how_its_made:
HyperDapp combines two powerful Web3 data layers to turn raw blockchain activity into a living dApp registry:

Real-time indexing with Substreams – The Graph’s Substreams capture contract deployments, events, and wallet interactions straight from the chain at high speed.

Relationship storage in Hypergraph – Every dApp, contract, wallet, and interaction is modeled as a node and edge inside a knowledge graph, making it easy to run complex queries and see connections.

Weighted reputation engine – Ratings are scored according to real usage. Active wallets carry more weight than one-off or dormant accounts, reducing spam and improving trust.

Front-end portal – A simple, wallet-connect interface lets users browse, rate, and verify dApps while seeing live usage metrics pulled directly from the graph.

By merging high-performance data streaming with a richly connected graph, HyperDapp gives the ecosystem a transparent, tamper-resistant source of truth about which dApps people actually use.
